title: VTC Booking — Pages — Delete — payload
description: The host deletes their booking page; every booking on it that has not started is cancelled and its booker told. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

reason.description: Shown to the bookers on each cancelled booking's event. Plain text.

Response.title: VTC Booking — Pages — Delete — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/booking/pages/delete/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/booking/pages/delete/0.1#response.

bookingsCancelled.description: Bookings that had not started, now cancelled.
